description: The image displays two side-by-side pie charts comparing the proportional breakdown of categories for "All Changes" on the left and "All Errors" on the right. Each chart consists of six slices, all of which are visually emphasized by being exploded, or offset from the center. A shared legend is positioned on the far right, identifying the categories by color: a light green square with an obscured or missing text label, dark green for "PW", light yellow for "R", dark yellow for "RW", light blue for "N", and dark blue for "NW". Percentage labels are placed outside the pie charts with thin leader lines pointing to their respective slices. In the "All Changes" chart, the largest slice is the light green category at 50%, followed by light yellow (R) at 26%, dark yellow (RW) at 14%, dark blue (NW) at 5%, dark green (PW) at 4%, and light blue (N) at 1%. In the "All Errors" chart, the light green category accounts for 56%, followed by light yellow (R) at 29%, dark yellow (RW) at 6%, dark blue (NW) at 5%, dark green (PW) at 3%, and light blue (N) at 1%. The segments are not arranged in a strict descending order of size, though the largest slice occupies the right half of both charts.
